overall_rationale: The must need N2 (hourly traffic near the monitoring stations) is unmet: the only traffic source has no documented counter-to-station mapping (rule 7), so it cannot be joined to the station data for the production window. N2 is must, so overall verdict is not_feasible. The other must needs are met with conditions: N1 via internal.airq.station_readings (production) and link.uci_360 (prototype, research-only licence, Legal review); N3 via api.open_meteo_archive (both windows, location and Legal sign-off needed) and link.lombardia_6eu4_4tja (prototype temperature only, Lombardy benchmark). N4 (should) is met with conditions via the aggregate clinic table. N5 (could) is unmet because the policy permits only aggregate counts. N6 (could) is partially met by the Eurostat annual national series for 2005 only. Re-assessment of N2 would be needed if the Mobility Office can supply a validated counter-to-station register.

Only production window served; diagnosis definition, district code list, Data Protection sign-off and suppression threshold are unconfirmed.
